data.content_ref: inline:Reduction: 21256139649b reduces to SRC_004's DefenseWitness the fragility profile that SRC_009 computes by single-edge deletion: a node is fragile iff some edge deletion removes every witness defender from at least one accepted defense set; causal mechanism is the witness as a certificate of acceptance. Refuted if a graph exists where a node's fragility flips without any DefenseWitness set changing.
